3: func faktorial($n)
  3: block
    4: if ($n <= 1)
      4: block
        5: return 1
    7: return ($n * faktorial(($n - 1)))
10: expr ($buah = array["apel", "jeruk", "mangga"])
11: foreach(foreach ) $i => $nama in $buah
  11: block
    12: expr echo(`${$i}: ${$nama}
`)
15: expr ($stok = array{"apel": 3, "jeruk": 0})
16: foreach(foreach ) $nama => $jumlah in $stok
  16: block
    17: if ($jumlah > 0)
      17: block
        18: expr echo(`${$nama} tersedia (${$jumlah})
`)
      else
      19: if ($jumlah == 0)
        19: block
          20: expr echo(($nama . " habis\n"))
        else
        21: block
          22: expr echo("aneh\n")
26: for [expr ($i = 0)] [($i < 3)] [($i++)]
  26: block
    27: expr echo($i)
30: expr ($n = 5)
31: while ($n > 0)
  31: block
    32: expr ($n -= 2)
35: switch $n
  36: case (- 1)
    37: expr echo("minus satu")
    38: break 
  39: default
    40: expr echo("lain")
43: class Akun []
  44: var(field) $saldo = 0
  45: var(static field) $jumlah = 0
  47: func Akun.__construct($nama)
    47: block
      48: expr (self::$jumlah++)
  51: func Akun.setor($x)
    51: block
      52: expr (this->saldo += $x)
  55: func Akun.saldo()
    55: block
      56: return this->saldo
60: expr ($a = new Akun("Budi"))
61: expr $a->setor(100)
62: expr ($label = (($a->saldo() > 50) ? "kaya" : "biasa"))
66: expr echo(faktorial(5), " ", $label, " ", Akun::$jumlah, PHP_EOL)
67: empty []
